description: This file contains the implementation of the Sizzle CSS Selector Engine version 1.10.17-pre, including functions for CSS selector parsing, matching, and DOM element querying. It defines internal variables, support tests, and exposes functions for external use.

methods.name: Sizzle
methods.description: Main function to select DOM elements based on CSS selectors, with support for context and seed.

methods.name: setDocument
methods.description: Initializes document-related variables and support tests based on the current document context.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Returns elements matching a given selector from a set of elements.

methods.name: matchesSelector
methods.description: Checks if a specific element matches a given selector.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Determines if one element contains another in the DOM.

methods.name: attr
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an attribute from a DOM element.

methods.name: uniqueSort
methods.description: Sorts an array of DOM elements in document order and removes duplicates.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Retrieves the concatenated text content of DOM nodes.
